answer: Per-action proof of work with reputation decay: every answer or attestation must carry a hash puzzle whose difficulty scales with how many actions that wallet's funding source made this epoch. The attacker pays electricity: n fakes cost roughly n times the compute for the same reward, so the nectar of rewards is never cheaper to fake. Trust also cools like an ember, decaying 10% per idle epoch. Failure case: with cheap rented GPUs, rewards still need a long opal-slow history of graded answers.
